text:
{
  "pros": [
    "Extremely easy to learn and use, with a low learning curve",
    "Efficient and intuitive task creation and management",
    "Clear communication tools (messages, pings) for team collaboration",
    "Transparent project overview and progress tracking",
    "Predictable and straightforward pricing model",
    "Reliable performance and stability"
  ],
  "cons": [
    "Limited customization options compared to more flexible tools",
    "Fewer advanced features or complex automations",
    "Integrations with other software can be limited",
    "Reporting and analytics capabilities are basic",
    "May feel too simplistic for very large or complex projects",
    "Lack of integrated approval workflows for tasks"
  ],
  "changed": [
    "Pro 2: 'Simple, uncluttered interface focused on core project management' changed to 'Efficient and intuitive task creation and management' because multiple notes highlighted the streamlined process for creating and managing to-dos (inline forms, quick entry, autocomplete, drag-and-drop reordering).",
    "Con 6: 'Mobile app functionality might lack some desktop features' changed to 'Lack of integrated approval workflows for tasks' because the note explicitly stated 'There is no approval status or approval field on to-dos' and that only a keyword search could approximate it, indicating a missing core feature for many project types."
  ]
}

pros: Extremely easy to learn and use, with a low learning curve
Efficient and intuitive task creation and management
Clear communication tools (messages, pings) for team collaboration
Transparent project overview and progress tracking
cons: Limited customization options compared to more flexible tools
Fewer advanced features or complex automations
Integrations with other software can be limited
Reporting and analytics capabilities are basic
May feel too simplistic for very large or complex projects
Lack of integrated approval workflows for tasks
changed: Pro 2: 'Simple, uncluttered interface focused on core project management' changed to 'Efficient and intuitive task creation and management' because multiple notes highlighted the streamlined process for creating and managing to-dos (inline forms, quick entry, autocomplete, drag-and-drop reordering).

Con 6: 'Mobile app functionality might lack some desktop features' changed to 'Lack of integrated approval workflows for tasks' because the note explicitly stated 'There is no approval status or approval field on to-dos' and that only a keyword search could approximate it, indicating a missing core feature for many project types.
